name: Violet Billow Burst
description: One sculpted violet plume with a bright pink foot and thin white base sweep. Connected shaded lobes stretch upward, release into three open curls, and fade against charcoal.

textures.prompt: One tall, connected, sculpted smoke lobe with rounded bulges and broad grayscale shading. Use several overlapping camera-facing sprite planes, normal blend, purple or pink tint. Width=2*radius, height=length.
textures.model: Codex imagegen (model not exposed), reusable library

textures.prompt: An open C-shaped smoke curl: a thick rounded lower-left root, lobed outer rim, a taper curling clockwise to the upper-right and a large empty center. Broad grayscale shading, transparent background. Use small camera-facing sprite planes with surface smoke and normal blend for curling detached wisps. Rotate Z and drift gently; do not reuse the round main lobe for every wisp.
textures.model: Codex imagegen (model not exposed), reusable library
